'''Relak Canyon''' was a canyon that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iol]]. The canyon was a byproduct of centuries of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on Iol, and was seven [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in width and up to one kilometer deep in places. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], mining in the canyon opened up a number of natural underground caverns and some miners suspected that [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits lay within the caves. However, safety protocols banned miners from exploring the caves. A number of preventative measures were taken by the miners across Relak Canyon to make the region safe, but despite their efforts, accidents and casualties were a common occurrence in the canyon.<ref name="TUR" />
